head.name: @fzlt/core/dice
head.lead: Seeded dice for tabletop games. roll(seed, n, sides) gives the values; dice() also builds a short tumble for each d6 (positions and orientations over time) that lands on the value the seed picked, so every player who rolls the same seed sees the same roll. - The values come from integer maths only (a 32-bit hash generator): the same seed gives the same values in every browser. The tumble is made to end on them (it is not a physics run that might land on an edge), so the face that lands up is the value by construction. The tumble is the look and never feeds a result: it keeps the builtin Math.sin, cos, acos and **, whose last bit may differ between engines (a path may differ in its last bits; the values never do), so an online sim reads value, never path. - The path is data: path holds frames samples per die of [x, y, z, qx, qy, qz, qw] (y up, the centre's height over the floor, a unit quaternion), and pose(i, t, out) reads it at any time. - dioramaDice builds the dice into an @fzlt/core/diorama scene (a chamfered body, pips painted on the faces that look at the camera) and shows them at a time; popDome puts them under a clear dome that you press: they jump, tumble and land. No allocation per roll, pose or show in the steady state (typed arrays, fixed capacity). Distances on the floor use steer's exact hypot (the builtin boxes its arguments).

sizesNote: Measured on this build: minified and gzipped with everything it imports, the way npm run size checks the budget in CI.

blocks.label: MODULES · hosted on this site
blocks.code: import { roll, euler, faceUp, dice, … } from "https://fizlet.com/dist/dice.js";

blocks.label: NPM · @fzlt/core
blocks.code:
npm install @fzlt/core
import { roll, euler, faceUp, dice, … } from "@fzlt/core/dice";

blocks.label: IN SHORT
blocks.code:
roll(seed, 2, 6, out); // the values alone: integer maths, the same in every browser
const dc = dice({ count: 2 }); // d6 with tumble paths that land on those values
const v = dioramaDice(d, dc, { on: "table" }); // into a @fzlt/core/diorama scene, pips painted
dc.roll(matchSeed + turn, { from: [-4, 0] }); // both players: the same seed, the same roll
v.show(t); // each frame, t seconds since the roll; dc.value → [3, 5]
